{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Finance teams cannot trust the numbers reported by Keelwater's claims-handling software because the totals displayed on the Management Information (MI) dashboard do not match the totals in the exported CSV files. This discrepancy causes confusion, delays in month-end reporting, and undermines confidence in critical financial data.

## Who is affected
- Finance teams at customer accounts, who are questioning which figures are correct and experiencing delays in their reporting cycles [i:02bd63a3409aa690][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].
- Account management teams, who are receiving direct feedback about the issue from their clients [i:2297961a34558bd4][i:d17400eba81e6607].
- Support teams, who are fielding a high volume of related inquiries [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa].
- Sales teams, who are also being made aware of the problem during client interactions [i:3c15351d383b6349].

## Evidence
The issue has been reported by 7 accounts, with a total of 14 mentions across three different routes: account_management (3 mentions), support (10 mentions), and sales (1 mention) [i:as_of].

- Thistlecombe Mutual (ARR £980,000.0) reported their finance team is pulling their hair out because the dashboard totals don't match the CSV exports [i:02bd63a3409aa690].
- Stannary Commercial (ARR £540,000.0) stated they are getting pushback from their finance team because the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file, causing a trust issue [i:2297961a34558bd4]. They also noted finance is questioning which one to trust [i:d17400eba81e6607].
- Tidewell Marine & Cargo (ARR £420,000.0) has mentioned the issue 4 times. Their finance team is questioning which figure is correct, causing delays in month-end close [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. A sales contact also flagged that the mismatch is causing real delays for month-end reporting [i:3c15351d383b6349], and a support ticket noted the mismatch is causing confusion [i:a4003abdfc3b22b1].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2,400,000.0) reported their finance team has noticed the report totals differ when comparing dashboard numbers with exported files, causing confusion [i:3c1cd3444487dcf6][i:8376bf1faade7ec1].
- Marrowgate Commercial (ARR £1,600,000.0) reported trouble with dashboard totals not matching the CSV export [i:4c1e1128bbb746cc]. They also stated finance keeps questioning the numbers, and the mismatch is consistent with a UTC cutoff, not UK time [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d].
- Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860,000.0) stated the mismatch is causing distrust in the numbers used for monthly reporting [i:551e3ef68cf180fa] and that their team is worried the numbers aren't reliable [i:711223638c96436d].
- Duncastle Auto (ARR £80,000.0) noted that after checking roles and tasks, the numbers still don't match what was submitted previously [i:c2ebffe834fdf50b].

The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £6,880,000.0 [i:as_of].

## Why now
The problem is actively disrupting critical business processes. Two of the affected accounts, Stannary Commercial and Marrowgate Commercial, have renewals due within the next 90 days (2026-12-05 and 2026-12-12, respectively) [i:as_of]. The issue is directly impacting finance teams during their month-end close cycles, causing reported delays [i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed][i:3c15351d383b6349]. The volume of support mentions (10) indicates this is a persistent and frequently encountered problem that requires immediate attention to maintain customer trust and contract stability.",
  "citations": ["02bd63a3409aa690", "e6a75fe1a41e39ed", "2297961a34558bd4", "d17400eba81e6607", "2e7168b298e234f6", "4c1e1128bbb746cc", "551e3ef68cf180fa", "3c15351d383b6349", "3c1cd3444487dcf6", "8376bf1faade7ec1", "a4003abdfc3b22b1", "ccfc25a70dd3f36d", "711223638c96436d", "c2ebffe834fdf50b"]
}
